actions_per_team_per_match.source: Public soccer-logs event dataset (Pappalardo et al. 2019, Scientific Data 6:236), 4 club leagues 2017/18 excluding England, computed by scripts/calibrate.py

pass_share.source: Public soccer-logs event dataset (Pappalardo et al. 2019, Scientific Data 6:236), 4 club leagues 2017/18 excluding England, computed by scripts/calibrate.py

pass_success_rate.source: Public soccer-logs event dataset (Pappalardo et al. 2019, Scientific Data 6:236), 4 club leagues 2017/18 excluding England, computed by scripts/calibrate.py

mean_pass_length_m.source: Public soccer-logs event dataset (Pappalardo et al. 2019, Scientific Data 6:236), 4 club leagues 2017/18 excluding England, computed by scripts/calibrate.py

shots_per_match.source: Public soccer-logs event dataset (Pappalardo et al. 2019, Scientific Data 6:236), 4 club leagues 2017/18 excluding England, computed by scripts/calibrate.py

goals_per_match.source: Public soccer-logs event dataset (Pappalardo et al. 2019, Scientific Data 6:236), 4 club leagues 2017/18 excluding England, computed by scripts/calibrate.py

home_goal_share.source: Public soccer-logs event dataset (Pappalardo et al. 2019, Scientific Data 6:236), 4 club leagues 2017/18 excluding England, computed by scripts/calibrate.py

ball_in_play_share.source: Wass et al. 2020, Science and Medicine in Football 4(2):142-147, citing an average ball-in-play time of 57.5 min over 300+ elite matches, about 60% of a 95 min match

sprint_threshold_kmh.source: Andrzejewski et al. 2013, Journal of Human Kinetics 39:191-200, 'Analysis of sprinting activities of professional soccer players': sprint above 24 km/h

sprint_min_duration_s.source: model default: a sprint must last at least 1 s (common convention in tracking studies)

sprints_per_player.source: Andrzejewski et al. 2013, Journal of Human Kinetics 39:191-200: 11.2 +/- 5.3 sprints per player per match in European club competition

distance_per_player_m.source: Bradley et al. 2010, Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research 24(9):2343-2351: total distance 10,841 +/- 950 m for elite domestic players

top_sprint_kmh.source: docs/CONTRACT.md: storyline threshold for a top sprint

max_accel_ms2.source: model cap: sustained player accelerations in smoothed 10 fps tracking stay around or below 5 m/s^2

top_speed_kmh_by_position.source: approximate: peak match speeds of elite outfield players mostly 29-35 km/h (widely reported in physical-performance literature); model default

fast_forward_kmh.source: approximate: the fastest elite players reach 35-36 km/h in matches; model default

jog_cap_fraction.source: model default: off-ball players run at most at this fraction of their top speed

shape_lag_s.source: model default: time constant of the team shape following the ball

off_ball_run_share.source: model default: share of sprints planted as off-ball runs; the rest come from players moving to action points

wander_m.source: model default: amplitude of the slow off-ball drift around each player's shape position

focus_cap_fraction.source: model default: players moving to an action point run at most at this fraction of their top speed

take_on_success_rate.source: Public soccer-logs event dataset (Pappalardo et al. 2019, Scientific Data 6:236), 4 club leagues 2017/18 excluding England, computed by scripts/calibrate.py

take_on_share.source: model default: share of on-ball decisions that are take-ons

cross_success_rate.source: Public soccer-logs event dataset (Pappalardo et al. 2019, Scientific Data 6:236), 4 club leagues 2017/18 excluding England, computed by scripts/calibrate.py

fouls_per_match.source: Public soccer-logs event dataset (Pappalardo et al. 2019, Scientific Data 6:236), 4 club leagues 2017/18 excluding England, computed by scripts/calibrate.py

yellow_cards_per_match.source: Public soccer-logs event dataset (Pappalardo et al. 2019, Scientific Data 6:236), 4 club leagues 2017/18 excluding England, computed by scripts/calibrate.py

offside_per_match.source: Public soccer-logs event dataset (Pappalardo et al. 2019, Scientific Data 6:236), 4 club leagues 2017/18 excluding England, computed by scripts/calibrate.py

throw_ins_per_match.source: Public soccer-logs event dataset (Pappalardo et al. 2019, Scientific Data 6:236), 4 club leagues 2017/18 excluding England, computed by scripts/calibrate.py

goal_kicks_per_match.source: Public soccer-logs event dataset (Pappalardo et al. 2019, Scientific Data 6:236), 4 club leagues 2017/18 excluding England, computed by scripts/calibrate.py

corners_per_match.source: Public soccer-logs event dataset (Pappalardo et al. 2019, Scientific Data 6:236), 4 club leagues 2017/18 excluding England, computed by scripts/calibrate.py

subs_per_team.source: model default: up to 5 substitutions are allowed under the current Laws of the Game

mean_carry_m.source: model default: mean length of a SPADL dribble (ball carry)

restart_weights.source: model default: relative share of dead-ball time before each restart

high_press_turnover_multiplier.source: model default: storyline magnitude, turnovers in the pressed half during a high-press spell

high_press_line_raise_m.source: model default: storyline magnitude, block pushed up during a high-press spell

tactical_shift_line_raise_m.source: model default: storyline magnitude for a raised defensive line
